description: v1.4 payload convention (SPEC 1.2.5): agent_action with payload.external_refs - the three canonical member shapes: artifact_sha256 (fingerprint of stable content), {system, ref} (third-party native id, declared as a value), message_id_sha256 (SHA-256 of the msg-id token of the header <20260802094107.5A2C@mail.example.com>, per the 1.2.5 algorithm; pinned by vectors/message-id/). The clear Message-ID SHOULD NOT be recorded. Declarative references: never resolved or checked at ingestion
